name: Steel & Shadows
tagline: Masters of the blade, and of the knife in the dark.
adds: The Battle Master: superiority dice and twenty maneuvers - trip, parry, riposte, rally, push, disarm, goad, frighten, sweep - used by you, your companions and offered with every blow
The Eldritch Knight, casting wizard spells between sword blows and calling a bonded weapon to hand
The Arcane Trickster, with an unseen hand that picks pockets and trips foes, and steals spells from the minds of casters
The poisons of the Dungeon Master's Guide: bought in black markets, milked from the slain, brewed, coated on blades and slipped into cups
Assassins, spies and spy masters in the world: thieves' guilds with work and poison, spies caught at court, duels of honour among some peoples

The fighter's and rogue's magic weapons: the Vorpal Sword, the Luck Blade, the Defender, the Dancing Sword, the Swords of Sharpness, Wounding, Answering and Vengeance, the Rod of Lordly Might and more
